subject: physics
summary: Physics is the strongest of these four: questions are typed at full size, and the scheme is a short tick-list of marking points with marks that reads the same on phone and desktop. The main fault is in the question stems: data tables are flattened into a run of numbers ('s (cm) 65 70 75 80 85 90 t (s) 0.36 0.38...'), a whole reading passage is poured into one paragraph with its headings merged in, and stems refer to a diagram or 'your graph' that is not on the card. Several scheme points are too terse to be an answer ('notation', 'force per', 'unit charge', 'one other detail', 'object') and carry app explanations of examiner shorthand instead of plain wording. A few attachments are wrong or unhelpful: one card shows a marking-scheme crop with answers to other parts in the question area, one opens an attached page on a different question, and one prints a junk 'Also on the diagram' box that repeats the stem twice.

issues.title: Data tables flattened into a run of numbers
issues.detail: Tables in the stem are printed as one line of text with no row or column breaks. Card 4: 's (cm) 65 70 75 80 85 90 t (s) 0.36 0.38 0.39 0.40 0.41 0.43'. Card 5: 'p (kPa) 100 120 140 160 180 220 V (cm³) 52 43 36 32 29 23'. Card 3: five labelled measurements run together ('mass of copper calorimeter (g) 64.6 initial mass of calorimeter + water (g) 144.7 final mass...'). The student has to work out which number belongs to which label.
issues.suggested_fix: Render the data as a real table (two rows for cards 4 and 5, a label/value list for card 3), or show a crop of the table from the paper.

issues.title: Reading passage shown as one wall of text
issues.detail: Card 6 prints a roughly 350-word passage as a single paragraph with its title and sub-heading merged into the sentences ('The Electricity Connection to your Home The electricity connection...', 'Making the Connection – Plugs and Cable Colours Almost all new...'). On the phone it fills more than a full screen column before the question appears. The question (P = IV with 13 A and 220 V) does not need the passage at all.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep headings and paragraph breaks, collapse the passage behind 'Read the passage' on the phone, and put the question first when it can be answered without it.

issues.title: Stem refers to something not on the card
issues.detail: Card 4 says 'She drew the following diagram to show the apparatus' but no apparatus diagram is shown. Card 5 asks 'Explain how your graph verifies Boyle's law' with no mention of which graph (the earlier part asked for it). Card 3's question ends in a comma ('calculate the mass of steam used,') because it is cut from a longer sentence. Card 8 says 'as shown' and the figure is two bare lines and a dot with no labels.
issues.suggested_fix: Add the apparatus figure or drop the sentence; add a line of context naming the graph from the earlier part; finish the sentence with a full stop.

issues.title: Marking-scheme crop with other parts' answers shown in the question area
issues.detail: Card 4 (draw the graph, Q1(vi)) shows a marking-scheme crop under the question after the reveal: the completed 2s and t² tables, which are the answers to parts (iv) and (v), with the text '(v) Copy and complete the table below...' and '[4 x 1]' from the other part. It sits where a question figure would be, is captioned 'marking scheme', and on the phone its numbers are about 5px high. The plotted values the student needs for the graph are useful, but this is not presented as such.
issues.suggested_fix: Give the completed table as typed 'values to plot' in the question, and show the official graph in the scheme.

issues.title: Attached page shows a different question with the same wording
issues.detail: Card 12 (2023 OL Q2(i), concave mirror) attaches a full page that opens on Section A instructions and the whole of Q1, whose part (i) is also 'Draw a labelled diagram of the apparatus used in this experiment' for a different experiment. Q2 only begins at the bottom edge. A student could easily answer the wrong experiment. The attachment adds nothing the typed question does not already say.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the attachment, or crop it to Q2.

issues.title: Scheme points too terse or split mid-phrase
issues.detail: Card 8 splits one definition into two tick boxes 'force per' and 'unit charge', and has a point reading just 'notation' with the note 'The scheme's // separates complete alternative methods; do not mix partial answers across methods' which explains examiner shorthand rather than giving the answer. Card 7 has 'one other detail' with no examples. Card 12 lists 'object', 'mirror', 'screen' with the heading 'All 3 of these — 6 then 3 then 3 marks' and a note about '[6 + 3 + 3]'. Card 4 repeats 'The scheme prints no answer here, only what earns the marks.' three times. Card 1 joins two lines with a slash: 'v = u + at / vV = 51.3 – (9.8 × 8) = –27.1'.
issues.suggested_fix: Write each point as a plain statement ('E = F/Q, with F, Q and E explained', 'force per unit charge'), give examples for 'one other detail', say 'first correct label 6 marks, then 3 each', and put the formula and substitution on separate lines. A labelled diagram from the scheme would help cards 7 and 12.

issues.title: Junk 'Also on the diagram' box
issues.detail: Card 11 shows a tinted box under the scheme headed 'ALSO ON THE DIAGRAM' with two entries, 'A —' and 'B —', each followed by the full stem sentence repeated word for word. It tells the student nothing and looks broken.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the box, or give real labels (A: charging position, B: discharging through the bulb).

issues.title: Question shown only as a small crop on the phone
issues.detail: Card 9's stem and question are an image crop, not text. On the phone the print is about 6px high, there is a tall blank gap inside the crop between the question and '(speed of sound...)', and the scheme crop below it is smaller still. The typed scheme points alongside are clear.
issues.suggested_fix: Type the stem and question as text and keep only the pipe diagram as an image, cropped tight.

issues.title: Decorative or unrelated pictures take space
issues.detail: Card 2 shows a large portrait of Janssen that fills most of a phone screen and has nothing to do with spectrometer adjustments. Card 6 shows the plug photo with labels A, B, C, which belongs to a different part of Q11. Card 10's keyboard photo is harmless. Slash-joined alternatives in card 11's scheme ('store charge / (radio) tuning / filtering / ...') read acceptably as a list of options but would be cleaner as chips.
issues.suggested_fix: Shrink or drop pictures that the part does not need, and show alternatives as separate chips.

issues.title: Empty band on the phone
issues.detail: A blank area of roughly 200-250px sits between the question block and 'Your answer' on most cards.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the minimum height on the question block on phones.

good_examples.why: Clear typed question, relevant photo, and a three-line scheme with a clean formula image and marks
Complete self-contained question and four scheme points with values and marks; identical on phone
'Any 3 of these — 2 marks each' list is exactly how this scheme should read
